name: jit_optimize_above_cost
description: Sets the minimum estimated query execution cost threshold above which JIT compilation applies optimization passes to generated code.
symptoms: No JIT optimization benefit despite high-cost queries
Suboptimal execution speed for complex queries
Wasted CPU cycles on unnecessary JIT optimization
tuning_tips: Set slightly above jit_above_cost to enable optimization only for sufficiently expensive queries; avoid values exceeding jit_inline_above_cost as diminishing returns occur. Use -1 to disable entirely.
